# metamcp_namespace (Data Source)

Looks up an existing MetaMCP namespace by name or UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Namespace name. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.
- `uuid` (String) Namespace UUID. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `updated_at` (String)
